changes.reason: End session now asks before ending a session no id_token_hint vouches for (RP-Initiated Logout 1.0 section 2): the end-session requests of this test carry the confirm value the confirmation page's link carries. Every assertion is unchanged: the store error is logged, audited, marked and the cookie is cleared; a healthy store emits none of that.

D-025 (owner ruling 2026-10-03): the restore of a soft-deleted tenant user ran as a site_admin; the test now asserts the site_admin is refused (ErrForbidden, deleted_at kept) and that the organization's own org_admin restores it. The recovery assertion is unchanged and one refusal assertion was added.

D-025 (owner ruling 2026-10-03): the PUT /users/:id active-wire cases ran as a site_admin on a tenant user; they now run as that organization's own org_admin. The three active/banned translation cases and their expected values are unchanged.
